title: The Neighborhood (TV series)
production_companies: A Bird and a Bear Entertainment
CBS StudiosCredited as CBS Television Studios for the first two seasons.
premise_summary: The Neighborhood is an American television sitcom created by Jim Reynolds that premiered on CBS on October 1, 2018. The series follows a white Midwestern family as they adjust to moving into a predominantly black neighborhood in Pasadena, California. It stars Cedric the Entertainer, Max Greenfield, Tichina Arnold, Beth Behrs, Sheaun McKinney, Marcel Spears and Hank Greenspan. In April 2024, the series was renewed for a seventh season; which premiered on October 21, 2024. In March 2025, the series was renewed for an eighth and final season which premiered on October 13, 2025.
